summary: Independent blind screening audit of Paper I (paper1_core_control_and_coral_npu.tex and references.bib) for bioRxiv (Systems Biology / Bioengineering) passed with zero blockers. The manuscript maintains strict human-only authorship with full institutional affiliation, transparent Google Antigravity for Science and human-verified AI workflow disclosures, complete bioRxiv declarations (Competing Interests, Ethics Statement, and MIASE code/reproducibility availability), and rigorous purely computational and host-emulated framing throughout the title, abstract, body, and limitations. Three minor non-blocking warnings are noted regarding an explicit Data and Code Availability subheading in Disclosures, exact Gemini model/plugin version specificity, and optional NumPy/Matplotlib citations.

warnings.detail: Code, scripts, and MIASE seed reproducibility are substantively provided in the title block (L51) and 'MIASE Reproducibility Manifest' (L397-L398), but adding a dedicated 'Data and Code Availability:' label inside the 'Acknowledgments and Disclosures' section (L486-L491) would make availability immediately scannable for bioRxiv screeners.

The disclosure properly credits the Google Antigravity for Science program, Google Antigravity, Gemini Pro, specific AI-assisted tasks, and full human verification by Wayne A. Satz, MD; specifying the exact Gemini model version string and explicitly noting that no external Science Plugin database skills were queried would further tighten attribution precision.
SciPy, L-BFGS-B, MIASE, RISC-V, and Coral NPU are formally cited in references.bib, whereas NumPy and Matplotlib (used in simulator/generate_paper1_verified_benchmarks.py) are not explicitly cited.
